modules.title: Automated Scene Capture & Chain of Custody
modules.description: Initiates high-priority forensic recording, biometric hashing, and immediate chain-of-custody timestamping for field scene documentation.
steps: Verify lens clearance and active GPS/telemetry feed.
Execute scene capture with full cryptographic payload signing.
Confirm payload receipt and local vault sync before ending session.
modules.troubleshooting: If cryptographic verification fails on initial handshake, clear local lockfile at /tmp/trust_lock and re-authenticate.

modules.title: Telemetry Heartbeat & Dead Man's Switch
modules.description: Monitors operator ping telemetry. Automatically triggers encrypted emergency fallback procedures if heartbeat signal drops beyond threshold.
steps: Configure ping intervals in local runtime settings (default: 300s).
Verify handshake sync through the transparent Trust-Shell barrier.
Set failover emergency alert routing and local key-wipe parameters.
modules.troubleshooting: Ensure socket port 8443 remains unblocked across local network routing.

modules.title: API Obfuscation & Relay Switch
modules.description: Reroutes field telemetry through multi-layer obfuscation relays to prevent signal intercept and traffic pattern analysis.
steps: Select active relay proxy profile from menu.
Confirm zero-knowledge log status on server response.
modules.troubleshooting: Latency exceeding 250ms indicates hop saturation. Force node rotation using --rotate-nodes.
